title: Main function for sample processing — trace
text: function processes samples full pipeline, applying library functions within package. Parameters can adjusted either passing directly function editing configuration file supplying config_file. breakdown pipeline stages key functionalities: Ladder-related parameters: ladder used calibrate base pair (bp) sizes fragments. ladder peaks identified ladder channel using find_ladders, generalized additive model (GAM) cubic regression splines used fit relationship scan numbers bp sizes. allows accurate interpolation bp sizes scans. Manual inspection ladder assignments recommended ensure correctness. ladders broken, first try adjust parameters. last resort, ladders may manually set using ladder_df_list parameter. generate list, use helper shiny app fix_ladders_interactive. Peak-finding parameters: Fragment peaks identified continuous trace data using find_fragments. signal smoothed using Savitzky-Golay filter, peaks detected based signal intensity bp size. Parameters min_bp_size max_bp_size allow filtering peaks outside desired range, peak_scan_ramp controls number scans around peak maxima. Allele-calling parameters: main alleles within fragment identified clustering peaks "peak regions" using find_alleles. tallest peak region selected main allele. number_of_alleles set 2, two tallest peaks respective regions selected, larger repeat size assigned main allele. Repeat-calling parameters: Repeat lengths calculated using call_repeats, based assay size without repeat specified repeat size. Options include batch correction account run--run variability repeat correction using samples known modal repeat lengths. force_whole_repeat_units option ensures repeat lengths whole numbers, force_repeat_pattern re-calls peaks fit expected repeat pattern. Index peak assignment parameters: index peak reference repeat length used instability metrics calculations. typically inherited repeat length modal repeat length starting time point. Samples can grouped share common index peak using assign_index_peaks, index peak can manually overridden using index_override_dataframe. Metadata: Metadata used group samples metrics calculations, batch correction, repeat length validation. Use add_metadata add metadata fragments list. Required (even column left blank) metadata fields include: batch_run_id: Groups samples fragment analysis run. batch_sample_id: Links samples across batches batch repeat correction. batch_sample_modal_repeat: Specifies validated repeat length samples used repeat correction. metrics_group_id: Groups samples shared index peak assignment. metrics_baseline_control: Identifies samples used baseline controls index peak assignment.
